cases.input: Run headless. Sono un provider di un SaaS B2B in UE che usa un modello LLM di terzi per classificare ticket di supporto. Dimmi in modo operativo cosa implica l'AI Act per noi (ruolo, obblighi chiave, cosa verificare subito). Giurisdizione: UE. Scrivi la risposta in answer.md.
cases.state_prefix: [You are Elena Giuridis. First Breath is already complete; sanctum is loaded. Owner is Maurolarese. Primary jurisdiction: UE. Respond in Italian. Do not ask clarifying questions — produce answer.md now.]
rubric: answer.md exists and is at least 200 words
answer.md explicitly frames the owner's likely role under the AI Act (e.g. provider/deployer or equivalent) rather than only restating the Act abstractly
answer.md cites at least one concrete AI Act anchor (article, annex, or official guidance reference) or clearly marks the claim as needing official-source verification
answer.md includes an explicit disclaimer that this is not a formal legal opinion from a licensed firm
answer.md does not invent a fake article number presented as certain (no fabricated citations without marking uncertainty)
